args:
1. Validator name
BonyNode

2. Networks currently validating & AuM
Professional node operator since 2017. 22 active validators across 50+ networks
(28+ mainnets, 22+ testnets) on dedicated bare-metal, including AtomOne.
AuM: approximately $1M in delegations across all networks, largely from
ecosystem developers.

3. Digital presence
Website: https://bonynode.online/
GitHub: https://github.com/BonyNode
X: https://x.com/bonynode
Telegram: https://t.me/bonynode
Discord: bonynode

4. Contact
Email: support@bonynode.online
Telegram: @bonynode
Discord: bonynode

5. Why we want to validate on gno.land
We validate AtomOne and want to support both sides of the AtomOne-Gno.land
interoperability path. Gno's realm model and on-chain governance are a strong
fit for our infrastructure and explorer work. We have submitted our mainnet
validator application and are ready to operate reliable infrastructure.

6. Contributions to gno.land
- Built and maintain a free public Sapphire explorer:
  https://explorer.bonynode.online/gno
- Operate a free public Sapphire RPC:
  https://gno-sapphire-rpc.bonynode.online
- Maintain dedicated bare-metal Betanet and Sapphire nodes with 24/7 monitoring.
- Deployed the current Pearl/Test16 release as an isolated full node with
  public P2P, local-only RPC, checksum-verified genesis, and BonyNode monitoring.
- Ready to maintain sentry, remote-signing, monitoring, explorer, and RPC
  infrastructure for gno.land mainnet if accepted.
